/usr/local/sbin/alma-portal-cert-deploy.content:
#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
IP="$(cat /etc/alma-portal/public-ip)"
SOURCE="/etc/letsencrypt/live/$IP"
test -s "$SOURCE/fullchain.pem"
test -s "$SOURCE/privkey.pem"
install -o root -g alma-portal -m 0640 "$SOURCE/fullchain.pem" /etc/alma-portal/tls/fullchain.pem
install -o root -g alma-portal -m 0640 "$SOURCE/privkey.pem" /etc/alma-portal/tls/privkey.pem
restorecon -R /etc/alma-portal/tls >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl try-restart alma-portal.service || true
if httpd -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl try-reload-or-restart httpd.service || true; fi

/etc/systemd/system/alma-portal-renew.se.content:
[Unit]
Description=Renew short-lived public IP TLS certificate
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/opt/alma-portal-certbot/bin/certbot renew --quiet --deploy-hook /usr/local/sbin/alma-portal-cert-deploy
TimeoutStartSec=300

/etc/systemd/system/alma-portal-renew.ti.content:
[Unit]
Description=Check IP certificate renewal twice daily

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 04:15:00
OnCalendar=*-*-* 16:15:00
RandomizedDelaySec=600
Persistent=true
Unit=alma-portal-renew.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

/etc/httpd/conf.d/00-alma-acme.conf.content:
# URL-level deny also covers inherited aliases and PHP/CGI handlers.
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerName 2.29.153.161
  DocumentRoot "/var/www/alma-acme"
  TraceEnable Off
  <Directory "/var/www/alma-acme">
    Options -Indexes -FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all denied
  </Directory>
  <Directory "/var/www/alma-acme/.well-known/acme-challenge">
    Options -Indexes -FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
  <LocationMatch "^/">
    Require all denied
    ErrorDocument 403 "HTTP is available only for certificate challenges."
  </LocationMatch>
  <LocationMatch "^/\.well-known/acme-challenge/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$">
    Require all granted
    SetHandler default-handler
  </LocationMatch>
  ErrorLog logs/alma-acme-error.log
  CustomLog logs/alma-acme-access.log "%a %t %m %U %>s %b"
</VirtualHost>

/etc/httpd/conf.d/02-alma-vicidial-ssl.c.content:
# All HTTPS paths require worker-confirmed IP state except the exact portal routes.
Listen 443 https
LuaAuthzProvider portal443 /opt/alma-portal-443/access.lua authorize
<VirtualHost *:443>
  ServerName 2.29.153.161
  LuaHookTranslateName /opt/alma-portal-443/access.lua browser_redirect early
  DocumentRoot "/var/www/html"
  SSLEngine on
  SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3
  SSLCertificateFile "/etc/letsencrypt/live/2.29.153.161/fullchain.pem"
  SSLCertificateKeyFile "/etc/letsencrypt/live/2.29.153.161/privkey.pem"
  AllowEncodedSlashes Off
  TraceEnable Off
  ProxyRequests Off
  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyAddHeaders Off
  <Directory "/var/www/html">
    Options -Indexes +FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
  ProxyPassMatch "^(/|/portal/|/portal/(?:login|grant|status|continue|logout|app\.js|app\.css|logo\.png))$" "http://127.0.0.1:19091$1" connectiontimeout=2 timeout=10
  <LocationMatch "^/">
    Require portal443
    ErrorDocument 403 "Access requires authorization at https://2.29.153.161/"
    Header always set Cache-Control "no-store, private"
    Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=604800"
  </LocationMatch>
  <LocationMatch "^(/|/portal/|/portal/(?:login|grant|status|continue|logout|app\.js|app\.css|logo\.png))$">
    RequestHeader unset X-Alma-Source
    RequestHeader set X-Alma-Source "expr=%{CONN_REMOTE_ADDR}"
    # Cached VICIdial Basic credentials must never authenticate at the portal.
    RequestHeader unset Authorization
    RequestHeader unset Proxy-Authorization
  </LocationMatch>
  ErrorLog logs/alma-vicidial-ssl-error.log
  # Avoid query strings, credentials, cookies and Referer in the migrated vhost log.
  CustomLog logs/alma-vicidial-ssl-access.log "%a %t %m %U %>s %b"
</VirtualHost>
